conf.description: crowdstrike-falcon, detection-summary dataset, syslog-kv format: tokenize the space-separated key=value line (quote-aware for values like CommandLine that contain spaces) into the crowdstrike.falcon.* namespace by literal key, tag event.dataset.

conf.comment: crowdstrike-falcon / detection-summary / syslog-kv. Keys are the flattened JSON field names (ComputerName=, UserName=, DetectName=, CommandLine=, ...), so no separate attribute reference exists -- but the field table for this dataset+format is empty in the work order, so no ECS target is asserted here without a guess. Every key=value pair is tokenized quote-aware (the map's own stated hazard is unquoted spaces in values like CommandLine) and landed under crowdstrike.falcon.<literal-key>.

functions.description: record the KV tokenization approach and why no ECS mapping is asserted

conf.code: var re = /([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=("([^"]*)"|(\S*))/g; var m; while ((m = re.exec(__e['_raw'])) !== null) { var k = m[1]; var v = (m[3] !== undefined) ? m[3] : m[4]; __e['crowdstrike.falcon.' + k] = v; }

functions.description: quote-aware key=value tokenizer: a quoted value (CommandLine) keeps its embedded spaces, an unquoted value stops at the next space
tag the dataset and drop the raw line now that every recognizable pair has been extracted
